title: EntityRevisionDiff
description: Computed difference between two retained revisions of one catalog entity (PRP-70; computed on read by PRP-76, never stored). Answers 'what changed between version N and M' including the declared-capability and tag diff of the original 5b story. changes is capped at 200 entries; truncated is true when more differences existed than were returned. before and after hold the compared values at that path (a scalar or a list, null when absent on that side; changed members of nested objects are reported as deeper paths, so a value is never an object) and are the entity's own field values, so the diff inherits the entity's visibility rules. Python validators: check_revision_version_order (from_version < to_version).

truncated.description: True when the changes list was cut at its cap.

change.title: EntityRevisionChange
change.description: One differing field. path is an RFC 6901 JSON Pointer into the entity document (one to six lowercase snake_case segments, no array indexes).

before.description: Value in from_version; null when op is added.

after.description: Value in to_version; null when op is removed.

capability_changes.title: EntityRevisionCapabilityChanges
capability_changes.description: Declared capabilities added to and removed from the entity between the two versions.

tag_changes.title: EntityRevisionTagChanges
tag_changes.description: Tags added to and removed from the entity between the two versions.
